result_contract.string_array_rules: Every element is a nonempty unique string.
result_contract.question_snapshot_rule: Exact question_ref, original_text bytes and ordered unit_refs from locked_identity.
result_contract.coverage_rule: covered_question_unit_refs and union of block question_unit_refs each equal the frozen denominator.
result_contract.block_rule: Nonempty blocks and citations; unique block_id/citation_id; every block has nonempty question_unit_refs and citation_ids; all references resolve.
result_contract.evidence_rule: Each evidence_ref names a source_map source_ref, READY book_id or current question_ref; HH03 also permits root or exact ancestor report_ref.
result_contract.private_byte_rule: Public original question, summary, block text/balance, uncertainties, limitations and safety_notes must not contain any nonempty exact private string from private_string_sources. Sources are frozen root materials and, for HH03, the current input plus root and every direct ancestor's report, envelope, execution, anchors, coverage and capacity proof. Reject without redaction or alteration; no language scoring. Valid citation identities remain governed by the reference contract.

chart_fact.locator: bundle-absolute RFC6901 pointer at or below that entry content_pointer
chart_fact.candidate_refs: exact enclosing candidate_ref/candidate_scope within that role source_map scope; invariant facts use empty; all uses the complete entry candidate_refs

prior_report.source_ref: frozen BZ05 report_ref; HH03 also permits root or exact ancestor report_ref
prior_report.locator: report-local RFC6901 pointer in the selected report terminal body, never bundle-absolute; source_map content_pointer selects BZ05 body only
prior_report.candidate_refs: exact enclosing candidate_scope within report role candidates; all uses complete report role candidate set; invariant passages use empty

classical_text.locator: existing macro/semantic locator or navigation node_id
